summary: Add a top-level spend-by-category command that rolls up outflow by Mercury category with a week-over-week delta.
reason: This read-only workflow composes one windowed /account/{id}/transactions read covering the current and prior period, then buckets outflows by mercuryCategory locally and computes the WoW delta. Uncategorized outflows fall into an explicit bucket; undated rows are dropped and counted. No new HTTP code.
